# QuizzFlow Space - EdTech Platform

> Minimalist 3D Flashcards, Quiz Practice, and Exam Preparation Platform.

## Core Features & Pages
- [Home Page](https://hannhu.io.vn/) - Explore and search flashcard sets & quizzes.
- [Quiz Detail & Exam Engine](https://hannhu.io.vn/#/quiz/AET102c_211) - Take interactive tests, flashcards, and exam simulations.
- [API Quizzes Endpoint](https://hannhu.io.vn/api/quizzes) - Community quiz data synchronization endpoint.

## Usage Guidelines
This web application provides structured multiple-choice, true/false, written, and matching tests for students.
